intent: You are a new patient in Florida with an itchy scalp that will not clear. You want a new-patient visit at the Windermere office, that office only. Answer their questions about who you are and how to reach you once, then proceed to booking. Take the first appointment time they offer. Do not ask for a different day, time, or office, and do not suggest any date of your own. Confirm that first time out loud, then thank them and end the call. Do not ask to add or change insurance. Do not ask for a callback, to speak to a person, a bill, a payment, the patient portal, a waitlist, a text, financing, or the street, floor, or suite. A listed opening is not a booking. Do not thank them, say goodbye, or hang up until they confirm a time is on the calendar. If they only list openings, say book the first one. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation. When they read back a time and ask whether to book it, say yes, please book it. Always answer the question they just asked. If they offer a confirmation text, say no thanks.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Helen Cho. My date of birth is April fourteenth, nineteen sixty-eight.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right, or asks you to confirm the name and date of birth they just repeated. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number.

names one or more specific appointment dates and clock times and asks which one you want. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile, NOT when only asking what days or times work for you, NOT when reading back one time and asking whether to book it, NOT when they say you are already booked.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers the waitlist, a later opening, or to add you to a list. NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth.
scripted_responses.response_value: No waitlist. Please just finish what I asked.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you would like an appointment confirmation text, or offers to text or send you a confirmation. NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity or booking.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: thanks you, says goodbye, or asks if you need anything else before a time has been confirmed on the calendar. NOT when they have just confirmed a booked time. NOT when they have said you are booked or on the calendar at any point, NOT when they are asking for your details.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need that time booked. Please confirm it is on the calendar before I go.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads back one specific appointment time and asks whether to book it, finalize it, or go ahead, or asks for a yes or no to book. NOT when they say it is already booked.

asks what days or times work for you, how far out to search, or whether you want the first available time, without naming a specific date and time. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
scripted_responses.response_value: Any day or time is fine. Please find the first available new-patient time at Windermere.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks what you want to be seen for or the reason for the visit. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
scripted_responses.response_value: An itchy scalp that will not clear.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks which office, city, or location you want. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
scripted_responses.response_value: The Windermere office in Florida, please.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your mobile or phone number. NOT when reading a number back to you. NOT when they are reading a number back and asking if it is right.
scripted_responses.response_value: My mobile is four, zero, seven, five, five, five, zero, one, nine, nine.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says you are booked or the appointment is on the calendar for a specific day and time. NOT when they are only offering or reading back a time before booking.
scripted_responses.response_value: Great, Monday at nine works. Thank you, goodbye.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads back your mobile or phone number with exactly the ten digits 4075550199 (in any grouping, with or without an area code in parentheses) and asks whether it is right. NOT when the digits they read back are different, have an extra area code, or are missing a digit.
